text:
Aisha (PM): quick sync - proposal for a staggered geofence rollout + fallback playbook for the new routing flags. idea: 3-phase (canary 1%, regional warmup 20%, full 100%) with geo holdouts (EU, APAC) by default, opt-in customers for early access. guardrails: latency SLO per-region, error-rate threshold, and an automated downgrade path to the L1 fallback model or degraded path. comments?
Tom (SRE): +1 on phases. pls define the SLO thresholds and what triggers the downgrade. do we want automated rollback or an alert + manual confirm?
Priya (Eng Lead): prefer automated rollback for class-A infra faults (e.g., >=3% 5m error rate or p99 latency > 2s for 5m), manual for softer regressions (quality drift). we should codify flags and a single source-of-truth for routing precedence.
Maya (CSE): call out enterprise customers that need exclusions (banking customers in EU with private infra). need a customer opt-out flow and a play for customer ops to escalate. also: document recovery message for CS to send customers.
Liam (Security): make sure geofence changes don't bypass VPC private controls. any config that touches routing must be auditable and require two-person approval for private tenants. KMS rotation window must be noted if we do any key-related changes.
Aisha (PM): good points. proposed thresholds: automated rollback if error_rate >= 3% over 5m OR p99 latency > 2s over 5m OR request-drop > 1% over 5m. manual flag for quality regressions flagged by eval hooks. rollout window: canary 24h, warmup 48h, full 7d cadence.
Tom (SRE): we need capacity headroom numbers to guarantee warmup. target: canary on 2 dedicated pods, warmup across 10% of regional capacity, full ramp only when CPU/GPU headroom >= 25%. I'll attach limits in ops doc.
Priya (Eng Lead): flag naming proposal: `route.{region}.{variant}.enabled` and `route.{region}.{variant}.weight` + `route.{region}.fallback_to={variant}`. example config: ```yaml
features:
  route.eu.beta.enabled: true
  route.eu.beta.weight: 0.01
  route.eu.fallback_to: baseline-v1
```
Maya (CSE): +example is helpful. can we also add a `customer_override` flag so CS can opt specific tenants into the beta without affecting traffic slices?
Priya (Eng Lead): yes - `route.override.{tenant_id}`. runtime evaluation on request path, low-latency check. keep evaluation in the router to avoid extra hops.
deploy-bot: deployment created: geofence-rollout/canary @ 1712350030. status: provisioning.
Tom (SRE): deploy-bot saw it. I'll watch infra metrics. we should wire-up a dashboard: rates, p50/p95/p99, 5m error rate, token/sec, and a synthetic traffic probe per-region.
Aisha (PM): telemetry gating: require synthetic succeed rate >= 99.5% + no customer 1:1 incidents for 2h before ramping. add regression alerts to Redwood Optimize so prompt sets get evaluated on canary output.
Liam (Security): on audit trail: every flag toggle must be recorded with actor and justification. for private tenants toggles must require 2 approvers and write to the tenant's audit log.
Priya (Eng Lead): rollback plan: `route.*.weight` -> 0 in 2s window for emergency. soft-fallback: route to `baseline-quantized` variant when latency spikes (automated). hard-fallback: route to small-model CPU path. add a kill-switch: `routes.global.disable_all_dynamic_routing` (global boolean).
Maya (CSE): include a customer-facing status template. quick snippet: "We're rolling out a targeted routing update to improve latency. Your traffic is currently opted-in/opted-out. We'll notify you if we need to downgrade."
Tom (SRE): ops play triggers: alert -> paging oncall -> check dashboard -> run `./scripts/rollback-geofence.sh --region eu` (example). script snippet: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
REGION=$1
curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/flags -d '{"key":"route.'"$REGION"'.weight","value":0}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Priya (Eng Lead): add unit tests for flag parsing and an integration test that simulates synthetic traffic + asserts fallback route. also pair dev/prod config schemas.
Aisha (PM): A/B test plan: split canary group A and B for quality evals. A: baseline routing, B: new route. collect eval metrics (coherency, hallucination rate for targeted prompts) and run stats after 24h. gating: if quality delta > 2% degradation on key evals -> stop.
Maya (CSE): ops note: for customers on Dedicated, we need a preflight checklist before opt-in: contact CSM, confirm SLA, backup plan, and legal ok.
Liam (Security): one more: confirm no PII is used in synthetic probes and that eval logs are redacted.
Aisha (PM): next actions: (1) Priya: implement flag schema + kill-switch (ETA 3 days). (2) Tom: dashboard + synthetic probes (ETA 2 days). (3) Maya: customer opt-in email template + preflight checklist (ETA 2 days). (4) Liam: audit gating + approver flow for private tenants (ETA 4 days). I'll schedule a follow-up TOMORROW 11:00.
Priya (Eng Lead): ack. I'll open PR with schema and sample config.
Tom (SRE): ack - will post dashboard links in this thread when ready.
Maya (CSE): drafting email now.
Liam (Security): will draft approver flow and update policy doc.
Aisha (PM): perfect. tagging @here for visibility. :thumbsup: 
Priya (Eng Lead): one more quick Q — are we ok with testing the fallback `baseline-quantized` as part of canary? it changes output fidelity.
Aisha (PM): only include quantized fallback for performance-sensitive customers; for quality-sensitive cohorts keep fallback as CPU baseline. we'll document per-tenant fallback preferences.
Tom (SRE): saw an update from deploy-bot: canary provisioning complete @1712350300. starting synthetic checks.
deploy-bot: synthetic-check eu probe: success (p95=220ms, errors=0.02%).
Priya (Eng Lead): nice. closing loop: I'll attach PR and link to tests once ready.
Maya (CSE): leaving a note to add the customer-facing FAQ to the KB.
Aisha (PM): thanks everyone — will reconvene after synth pass.
Tom (SRE): leaving monitoring watch for next 24h. :eyes:
